report.summary: Closure audit of frozen change fd010a03→0eb8bbef (21 paths) for the operational report audit goal. All six findings from the initial Claude audit (run 3bc83cff, against fd010a03..d3cb1e0e) have verified dispositions in the head diff: (1) VendorNotConfiguredError now penalizes only explicitly selected vendors, with a default-discovery no-penalty regression; (2) structured-output exhaustion with free-text fallback records fallback_recovered (4/5) with a dedicated test; (3) direct HTML render reports integrity as 'not applicable (in-memory rendering)' or 2/5 'unverified' for an uncheckable claimed publication, both pinned by tests; (4) the missing milestone-2 proofs now exist — real-callback truncation capture, interrupted-graph resume with observation carryover, a second independent same-ticker/date run, and saved-state binding; (5) the reducer's identity rejection is retained as the deliberate mixed-run boundary with resume idempotence proven; (6) the procedural open-goal state is honestly documented, with the correction build, portable/rendered output proof and a 3,040-test suite on the corrected source recorded in the acceptance evidence. Independent tracing of both committed synthetic proofs confirms the deterministic rule reproduces the clean 5/5 (18 valid run-bound completed observations, matched identity, verified export) and the degraded 3/5 (two vendor_unavailable rows for get_news yfinance driving the most-serious finding into footer, HTML and linked audit with correct locators). Scoring never averages, source severity is never rating authority, foreign or stale observations cap at 2/5, reused destinations get digest-suffixed companions, audit-only failure yields Unrated with no stale link, and publication identity, decisions and history are untouched. No critical, high or medium defects found; remaining items are low-severity residual risks and manifest-boundary verification gaps. On this evidence, every confirmed material gap has verified closure and the closure gate can be satisfied for head 0eb8bbef, subject to the listed limitations.
limitations: Frozen-manifest review only: no commands were run against the repository; the reported suite results (3,040 passed, 10 skips on the corrected source), Ruff and git diff --check outcomes were not reproduced.

Unchanged dependencies (dataflows.files.locked/replace_file, evidence_snapshot allowlist, resolve_summary, cli/run.py streaming path, publication verification internals, the router's pre-existing 'explicit' flag) are outside the frozen diff and were accepted on the strength of the acceptance record and passing-test claims.

The synthetic-proof SHA-256 artifact hashes and the external rendered proof directory (PDF/PNG portable-folder inspection under /Users/zipp/Documents/ChatGPT/Tauric/output/...) could not be recomputed or opened; their description in the acceptance record is the sole evidence of visual/print verification.

ContextVar propagation of record_operation into threaded tool execution under LangGraph could not be verified from the diff; a propagation gap would silently drop tool-level observations rather than corrupt scoring.
The two traced scores come from the committed synthetic offline fixtures (injected faults through the real graph/finalizer), not from live provider runs; this matches the plan's acceptance basis.

findings.title: Residual by-design risk: merge_observations/observation raise ValueError inside the LangGraph reducer, so a mid-run identity or run_settings digest change would abort a live run; disposition 'no current defect' is reasonable and resume/replay are tested, but the abort path itself has no test demonstrating graceful behavior

Events recorded inside a node that later raises are discarded (observed_node writes rows only on successful completion); coverage relies on re-execution after resume, and this blind spot is not explicitly disclosed as partial coverage in the audit text

Key closure claim 'operational_observations excluded from evidence_snapshot/publication identity' rests on the acceptance record; the allowlist file is unchanged and outside the frozen diff, so it could not be independently confirmed from the manifest

The vendor-skip fix depends on a pre-existing 'explicit' flag whose definition is not visible in the frozen diff hunks; its semantics (explicitly selected vs default-discovered chain) are inferred from tests and the acceptance record, not from inspected source

Rating input 'Models/tools' surfaces only the first (most serious, alphabetically first) model/tool issue code; a run with multiple distinct failure classes compresses to one label in the footer, though the full audit lists all material findings
